name: wait for the initial document
A1 open Actions panel, initial 4/4 steps and 0.1740 m3
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;await h.actions();const s=await h.stepsNow(s=>s.n===4,150000,'demo steps loaded');h.ok(s&&s.k===4&&s.n===4&&Math.abs(s.vol-0.174)<1e-3,'initial '+h.json(s));window.__v0=s.vol;return h.json(s)})()

name: A2 pointer-click stepper Decrease
A2b stepper Decrease -> 3/4
A3 pointer-click stepper Increase
A3b stepper Increase -> 4/4
A4 Add Step (Execute) -> n=5, volume changes
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;await h.form('Add Step…');await h.exec();const s=await h.stepsNow(s=>s.n===5,75000,'n=5');h.ok(Math.abs(s.vol-window.__v0)>1e-4,'volume unchanged '+s.vol);window.__v5=s;return h.json(s)})()

name: A5 Undo restores 4 steps and original volume
A6 Redo re-applies 5 steps
A7 Undo back to 4
A8 Artifact panel rows for the demo steps
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;h.click('Artifact');await h.until(()=>h.find('Cut Lap Joint'),75000,'rows');const l=h.labels();for(const e of ['Crosscut To Length','Cut Lap Joint','Drill Dowel Hole','Insert Dowel'])h.ok(l.includes(e),'row '+e+' in '+h.json(l));return h.json(l)})()

name: A9 eye toggle disables Cut Lap Joint -> volume changes
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;const b=h.row('Cut Lap Joint').querySelector('button[data-slot=action]');b.click();await h.until(()=>{const s=h.steps();return s&&Math.abs(s.vol-window.__v0)>1e-4},75000,'volume change');const s=h.steps();window.__veye=s.vol;return h.json(s)})()

name: A10 eye toggle again restores volume
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;const b=h.row('Cut Lap Joint').querySelector('button[data-slot=action]');b.click();const s=await h.stepsNow(s=>Math.abs(s.vol-window.__v0)<1e-4,75000,'volume restored');return h.json(s)})()

name: A11 row context menu Remove deletes Insert Dowel
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;await h.ctxmenu(h.find('Insert Dowel'),'Remove');const s=await h.stepsNow(s=>s.n===3,75000,'n=3');h.ok(!h.labels().includes('Insert Dowel'),'row still there');return h.json([s,h.labels()])})()

name: A12 Undo restores removed step
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;h.click('Undo');const s=await h.stepsNow(s=>s.n===4,75000,'n=4');await h.until(()=>h.labels().includes('Insert Dowel'),75000,'row back');return h.json(s)})()

name: A13 select row then Remove Selected Step
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;h.click('Drill Dowel Hole');await h.wait(800);await h.form('Remove Selected Step');const s=await h.stepsNow(s=>s.n===3,75000,'n=3');await h.until(()=>!h.labels().includes('Drill Dowel Hole'),30000,'row removed');return h.json([s,h.labels()])})()

name: A14 Undo restores
A15 Inspection shows the selected step
A16 Inspection edit Width 0.3->0.1 changes volume
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;const w=document.querySelector('input[aria-label=Width]');h.setInput(w,0.1);const s=await h.stepsNow(s=>Math.abs(s.vol-window.__v0)>1e-4,75000,'volume change after width edit');await h.until(()=>Math.abs(+document.querySelector('input[aria-label=Width]').value-0.1)<1e-6,75000,'width value kept');return h.json(s)})()

name: A17 Inspection Move Later reorders steps
A18 Inspection Move Earlier restores order
A19 Inspection label edit renames row
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;const l=document.querySelector('input[aria-label=Label]');h.setInput(l,'Renamed Lap');await h.until(()=>h.labels().includes('Renamed Lap'),75000,'renamed row');return h.json(h.labels())})()

name: A20 focus the viewport for key tests
A21 [ key presses
A22 [ steps the cursor back
A23 ] key presses
A24 ] steps the cursor forward
A25 select a row, then Delete key
A26 Delete removed the selected step
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;const s=await h.stepsNow(s=>s.n===window.__d0.n-1,75000,'n-1 after Delete');await h.until(()=>!h.labels().includes('Insert Dowel'),30000,'row removed');return h.json(s)})()

name: A27 Meta+z undo
A28 Meta+z restored the step
A29 Meta+Shift+z redo
A30 Meta+Shift+z re-applied the removal
A31 Escape does not break the app
A32 app still alive after Escape
